name: Rapid Draw [Psionic]
body:
You are able to form your blade more frequently each round.

Prerequisite: Alter blade blade skill, quick draw class feature, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You may form your mind blade as a free action an additional number of times per round equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).
Normal: You may form your mind blade as a free action once per round.
